integrity: All stated new character values and decompositions are computed by a self-contained exact integer chain checker; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the rational vertex-relabeling representations in reduced degrees four and five of the single complex \(D_{6,3}\) are classified.
No integral representation-lattice, modular, or equivariant homotopy classification is asserted.
title: Complete \(S_6\)-homology characters of the six-vertex domination complex
